          $gate = Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeEmulatedProviderGate.ts'

          & $controller $node $runner --tsconfig $tsconfig $gate "$env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-fixture.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-birth-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-accounting-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-release-delay.exe" "$env:HOST_PROCESS_SCOPED_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" $receipt --test-source-provider codex 2>&1 | Tee-Object process-acceptance-evidence/windows-source-codex.log
